products.title: Compact espresso, 54 mm
products.reason_to_buy: The one we would put in a small kitchen: heats in seconds and takes 54 mm accessories you can actually find.
products.detail: Small footprint, fast heat-up, and a 54 mm portafilter. Measure your cabinet clearance before you buy; the tank fills from the top.
products.image_alt: Compact stainless espresso machine with its water tank lifted, a grinder beside it, on a quartz counter

products.title: Espresso burr grinder
products.reason_to_buy: Fine enough for espresso, quiet enough for a 6 a.m. house, and it fits under a cabinet.
products.detail: A stepped burr grinder with a true espresso range. Pair it with any 51 to 58 mm machine.
products.image_alt: Three compact espresso machines lined up on a counter with a tape measure along the front edge

products.title: Starter espresso, 51 mm
products.reason_to_buy: The budget pick, with one catch: it takes 51 mm baskets, and most accessory kits do not.
products.detail: Simple, small and cheap to start with. Buy 51 mm accessories only; 54 mm tools will not fit.
products.image_alt: Two portafilters of different sizes on a counter beside a steel ruler and a tamper
